thread:
julia: heads-up — hit a weird failure deploying mono (pnpm workspace) to Next edge: bundler can't resolve deep import `@redwood/sdk/stream`. Works in node dev, fails in edge build.

julia: build error: `Error: Could not read package.json for '@redwood/sdk' to resolve exports map` when resolving '/workspace/node_modules/@redwood/sdk/stream'

mark: classic pnpm virtual store + symlink issue. esbuild/rollup used by edge runtimes sometimes won't follow the .pnpm symlink to read package.json exports.

tyler: quick checklist we use: 1) avoid deep imports (import from main entry) 2) add explicit subpath exports in SDK package.json (e.g. "./stream": {"import":"./dist/stream.mjs","require":"./dist/stream.cjs"}) 3) add top-level `module` and `types` fields as fallbacks so older bundlers and editors can resolve a file.

lisa: +1. Also for monorepo dev flow: try `public-hoist-pattern=@redwood/*` in .npmrc to hoist package.json to top-level node_modules so builders find exports. Tradeoff: changes hoisting behavior for the whole repo.

julia: tried adding `./stream` export and publishing locally — that fixed the runtime but TS/LSP still complained: `Cannot find module '@redwood/sdk/stream' or its corresponding type declarations.`

mark: for types add an explicit subpath in exports pointing to `dist/stream.d.ts` or include `typesVersions`/top-level `types` that reference the d.ts files. Editor resolves types differently than Node bundlers.

tyler: alternative non-invasive fixes: - Vite/Next alias to dist file: `resolve.alias['@redwood/sdk/stream'] = path.resolve(__dirname, 'node_modules/@redwood/sdk/dist/stream.mjs')` and in tsconfig `paths` point to the d.ts. - Next: `transpilePackages: ['@redwood/sdk']` to force bundling. - Vite: `optimizeDeps.include = ['@redwood/sdk']` for pre-bundling.

lisa: small gotcha: avoid hardcoding .pnpm internal paths (they include versions/peers) — brittle. Prefer alias to top-level node_modules (if hoisted) or use a shim package.

julia: we also experimented with a tiny `packages/sdk-shim` that re-exports dist files and has a plain package.json (module/types). Apps depend on the shim instead of original package. Ugly but stabilizes CI and editors.

tyler: one more: some bundlers/node run with `--preserve-symlinks` differences. If CI uses different node flags than local dev, resolution can diverge. worth checking node version and flags.

mark: action items: 1) SDK repo: propose adding explicit subpath exports for public deep imports and top-level `module` + `types` fallback (open GH issue) 2) DevEx docs: add troubleshooting note listing three patterns (subpath exports, alias+tsconfig paths, shim + hoist .npmrc) and which providers each works for (Vercel/Next, Cloudflare, Netlify) 3) examples: add `examples/mono-pnpm-edge` showing Vite alias + tsconfig paths and a minimal .npmrc snippet.

devops-bot: Created ticket DX-900: "pnpm workspace + edge: deep-import exports & types" (priority: P2)

sdk-bot: Created issue SDK-140: "add subpath exports + module/types fallback to reduce pnpm/edge breakages"

julia: I'll attach failing logs and a minimal repro to DX-900 and try alias + tsconfig paths first for the example PR. Thx all :pray:
